A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] '''cyborg''' was the master of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Fomadu]] and [[Mei (Dark Jedi)|Mei]]. The [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] master and his followers did not believe in either the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] or the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and instead worshipped the [[Chaos/Legends|Great Void]], which they saw as the only truth.<ref name="Lone Wolf" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The unidentified cyborg master was first mentioned in the short story ''[[Lone Wolf: A Tale of Obi-Wan and Luke]]'' by [[Abel G. Peña]]. In a forum post on the [[Jedi Council Forums]], Peña stated that the intended implication behind the cyborg master's identity was that he was in fact [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], tying into his resurrection in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' and his appearance in the ''[[Star Wars: Visionaries]]'' comic "[[Old Wounds]]."<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/52381816|board=Literature|thread=Abel G. Peña's "Skyewalkers" and "Lone Wolf"|user=[[Abel G. Peña|Halagad_Ventor]]|date=2015-05-11|time=8:59 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180314000518/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/abel-g-pe%C3%B1as-skyewalkers-and-lone-wolf.50027998/page-7}}</ref>
